**Green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

Only 3 cases were ever red, all in `order totals`. `orderTotal` taxed the pre-discount base. The spec taxes what the customer pays.

One line in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) now taxes the discounted amount.

Rows with a zero discount or zero tax hid this. Only the three rows with both non-zero caught it.

Next: nothing. The fix is verified.
